readiness_rules: high risk without governance ref blocks
only READY readiness can form a TaskCandidate
decision_mapping: Decision Governance emits DecisionToActionTaskHandoffCandidateV1 with task_created=false; a future narrow adapter must submit a Task Manager candidate/input, never let Decision Governance create a task directly.
cancellation_interruption: Task Manager owns lifecycle transitions, interruption, recovery, cancellation and termination candidates; B3 does not execute them.
b3_stop: Decision Candidate/handoff → Task Candidate/readiness candidate; no scheduler, runtime, device or action side effect.
